newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet to consider confidence vote - agencies.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet to consider confidence vote - agencies.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi was due to call a cabinet meeting at 0745 GMT on Wednesday and would consider calling a vote of confidence in the Senate on a draft law on immigration, Italian news agencies reported.
A spokeswoman at Prodi's office, reached by telephone on Tuesday evening, said no official announcement on a cabinet meeting for Wednesday had been issued.
The Senate (upper house) was scheduled to discuss the immigration draft law on Wednesday.

News agencies, quoting unidentified parliamentary sources, said the cabinet would discuss whether or not to call a vote of confidence on the immigration bill, which the centre-right opposition has said it will vote against.
Prodi's centre-left coalition holds a majority in the Senate.
